attemptId.description:
The attempt the state describes — the latest one: the delivered attempt
of a running / completed command, the terminal one of a failed or
interrupted command. null while the command is still queued.

runtimeTurnId.description:
The runtime's own turn id for that attempt — the `turn` its records
carry — once the runtime named it (codex, opencode, pi name their turns
in the echo; claude's session names the transcript turn its dispatch
opened, #498); null before that.

turnStarted.description:
Did the runtime start a turn for that attempt at all (a `turn_started`
observation)? A command with none — a slash / `!` command the runtime
handled, a message the daemon handled itself — has no runtime output to
attribute: its completion IS its result.

looseTmux.description: Servers and stale sockets under the tmux socket dir that nothing owns.

observedAt.description: Timestamp of the rollout event the data came from (staleness signal).

pick.description: The app shows a model picker.

source.description:
Where the catalog comes from: a fixed list in the app (claude), the
machine (codex/opencode/pi/agy: GET /v2/harnesses/:h/models), or none.

switchLive.description: The model can be changed on a running session (joy-set-model).

levels.description: Fixed levels; empty when `perModel` (read them off the catalog entry).

effort.description: null = the harness has no effort/thinking knob.

permissions.description: null = no permission surface at all.

extraArgs.description:
"cli": raw arguments appended to the launch line; "config": codex
`key=value` config overrides; null: nothing to append to (a server).

sessionId.description: The session id the label names, if it parses as one.

id.description: "<providerID>/<modelID>" — the app's stable handle; providerIDs never contain "/".

recommended.description: The curated pair: what a fresh allowlist shows.

variants.description: Reasoning variants (the model's `variants` keys) — its effort levels.

recommended.description: The curated pair: what a fresh allowlist shows.

thinking.description: pi reports whether the model supports thinking (the --thinking knob).

depth.description: Distance from the root: 0 for the agent, 1 for its direct children…

args.description: Full command line where readable; else the name.

cpuPercent.description: Percent of one core, this process alone, over the sample window.

resumeId.description:
The conversation to resume, in whatever the agent calls it. Absent means
the folder can be reopened but the history cannot — worth restoring, and
worth saying so.

lastSeenAt.description:
When this session was last touched, from its record's mtime. The record
is written on every material change, so it is the closest thing to "when
did you last work on this" that survives a reboot — and it is what both
"most recent first" and "restore the latest in this project" need.

live.description: A live process in the registry right now (running or detached).

tmux.description: This session's own tmux server, when one is up (or its socket lingers).

newestAt.description: Newest mtime across its files (and the record's updatedAt), epoch ms.

parts.description: What was found, for the row's detail line.

process.description:
Live CPU/RAM of the agent's process tree — stamped by the single-session
`get` op only (sampled; see domain/procStats).

current_effort.description:
The effort / thinking level the harness is running with (codex: next
turn's; opencode: the model variant; pi/agy: the launch flag).

permission_mode.description:
The permission mode the harness is running with, where the daemon owns
it (codex/opencode/pi/agy; claude's is read off the pane).

tmux_socket.description: Per-session tmux server socket label (-L), null on the shared server.

summary.description: Conversation title (Claude's ai-title or a manual /title), aka the relay summary.

busy.description: Turn/dispatch/queue activity — the scripting "can I ask now?" signal (see busy()).

orphanBytes.description: Files under the state dirs whose session no record names.
